_note: 秘密図書倶楽部。28歳の市立図書館の司書が、社会人の常連利用者（成人男性）を『会員制の集まり』に誘い、閉館後の館内で倶楽部活動と称して30日かけて言いなりにしていく。主導権は完全にヒロイン側。からかう・焦らす・言わせる・我慢させる。夏の設定（冷房の効かない閉架書庫・汗・扇風機・麦茶・蝉・夏期開館の延長）。内容は非性的。登場人物は全員成人。
_panels: 1ビート=4枚。2枚ずつを1ページにまとめた2コマのページを2枚（引き・寄り・角度・反応で4構図）

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), calm expression, faint amused smile,
poses: wide shot of a quiet library reading room in summer, tall windows with white light outside, standing behind the lending counter holding a small printed card out, looking at viewer,
close up of the small card pinched between two fingers, only a handwritten club name and a number on it,
shot from between tall bookshelves, looking past rows of book spines toward her at the distant counter,
medium shot, resting both elbows on the counter and leaning forward slightly, chin lifted, watching for a reaction,
lines: うちの図書館、　会員制の　集まりが　あるんです
そんなの　聞いた　ことないですけど
lines2: あなた、　向いてそう。　入りません？
……何を　する　会なんですか

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), unreadable look, slight smile,
poses: wide shot of the lending counter, holding up one finger, a stack of books beside her, looking at viewer,
extreme close up of a raised index finger in front of her glasses, lens catching the window light,
high angle from above the counter, looking down at the books and her upturned face,
medium shot, lowering the finger and tapping it twice on the counter top, waiting,
lines: 条件は　ひとつ。　わたしに　逆らわないこと
lines2: さあ。　どっちだと　思います？
目が　笑って　ないんですけど

poses: wide shot of the reading room in late afternoon, strong summer light through tall windows, pinning a notice about extended summer hours to a board,
close up of the pinned notice, the closing time written large, a fingertip still on the corner,

medium shot, turning away from the board and looking straight at viewer, arms folded,
lines: 夏は　閉館が　一時間　延びるんです
lines2: つまり、　一時間　長く　居られる
早く　帰れって　言ってたのは

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), calm expression, finger to lips,
poses: wide shot of a silent reading room, cicadas outside the open window, standing beside a long table with a finger raised to her lips toward viewer,

shot from across the reading table, empty chairs in the foreground, her standing beyond them,

lines: しー。　声、　大きい
まだ　何も　言ってないです
lines2: 息が　うるさいの。　止めてて
無茶　言わないで　ください

poses: wide shot of the staff corner behind the counter, a sweating glass pitcher of cold barley tea on the desk, pouring a cup without looking up,
close up of the cold glass held out, condensation running down the side and over her fingers,
high angle looking down at the desk, the pitcher, two cups and her hands from above,
medium shot, pulling the cup back a few centimetres just as it is reached for, smiling,
lines: はい、　麦茶。　……飲んで　いいとは　言ってない
もう　口　つけました
lines2: 勝手に　飲むんだ。　覚えて　おきます
記録　しないで　ください

poses: wide shot of the counter, sitting at the terminal with the lending record open, glancing sideways at viewer,
close up of a hand resting on an open lending ledger, a long column of dates under the palm,

lines: 今月、　十一回。　暇なんですか
本を　読みに　来てます

poses: wide shot of the reading room corner, an old electric fan turning on a stand, standing in front of it with eyes closed,
close up of the fan grille and loose strands of hair lifting in the air stream,
side view in profile, the fan in the foreground, her standing beyond it, window light behind,
medium shot, stepping aside and turning the fan away from viewer with one finger, smiling,
lines: この一台しか　ないんです
こっちにも　少し　ください
lines2: 会員に　なってから　言って
そこで　使うんだ、　それ

poses: wide shot of the staff corner behind the counter, a box of donuts open on the desk, turning toward viewer holding one up,
close up of the donut held out on a paper napkin in an open palm, just out of reach,
high angle looking down at the desk, donut box, paper cups and her hands from above,
medium shot, taking a bite herself instead, covering her mouth, eyes smiling at viewer,
lines: もらいもの　です。　……手は　使わないで
どうやって　食べるんですか
lines2: 考えて。　待ってます
結局　自分で　食べてますよね

poses: wide shot of the reading room with half the lights already off, evening still bright outside, standing at the wall microphone,
close up of her mouth near the announcement microphone, one hand cupped lightly around it,
shot from the far end of the room over rows of empty chairs, a single lit figure at the microphone,
medium shot, lowering the microphone and pointing at the chair in front of her without a word,
lines: まもなく　閉館です
lines2: あなたは　座ってて。　まだ　帰さない

poses: wide shot of the counter after closing, writing on the small club card with the last daylight behind her,
close up of the card, a single digit and a name written on it in fountain pen,
view from behind the reserve shelf, her framed between stacked books in the foreground,
medium shot, sliding the card across the counter and holding one finger on it so it cannot be taken yet,
lines: 会員番号、　一番です
他に　誰も　いないってことでは
lines2: 最初から　僕だけ　ですか

poses: wide shot of a heavy door marked staff only, pushing it open and holding it for viewer, dim hot stacks beyond,
close up of a hand on the door handle, a ring of keys hanging from one finger,

lines: ここ、　冷房　入ってないので
lines2: 倶楽部活動は　ここ。　逃げても　いいですよ
逃がす　気　ないでしょう

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), looking down at viewer,
poses: wide shot of the closed stacks aisle, standing high on a rolling ladder looking down over one shoulder,
close up of a hand gripping the ladder rail, the other hand pointing down at viewer,
low angle from the floor looking straight up the ladder, tall shelves towering on both sides,
medium shot from high on the ladder looking down the aisle, dim work lights below,
lines: そこ、　動かないで　支えてて
lines2: わたしが　降りるまで。　当たり前でしょう
降りる　気　あります？

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), composed, close to viewer,
poses: wide shot of a very narrow aisle between rolling stacks, squeezing past viewer sideways in the heat,
extreme close up of two shoulders almost touching in the dark, damp blouse fabric brushing a sleeve,

medium shot, stopping halfway past and staying there, looking up without moving,
lines: 通ります。　動かないで
これ以上　下がれない　です
lines2: 下がれとは　言ってない。　我慢して

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), faint sweat on skin, teasing smile,
poses: wide shot of the hot stacks, standing with her back to viewer pressing a cold barley tea can to the back of her neck,
close up of the nape of her neck under the low chignon, a bead of sweat running down, loose strands stuck to the skin,

medium shot, turning around and catching where viewer was looking, one eyebrow raised,
lines: ……今、　どこ　見てました？
lines2: 見てたって　言うまで　帰しません

poses: wide shot of the dim closed stacks, leaning in close to whisper, both standing between the shelves,

medium shot, pulling back a little and smiling, very pleased with the reaction,
lines: ここ、　響くので。　声、　出さないで
その距離で　言うの、　ずるいです
lines2: 我慢して。　それも　活動の　うち

poses: wide shot of the stacks aisle, holding an open book out at arm's length toward viewer, one finger on a line,

medium shot, closing the book on her own palm and shaking her head slowly, unimpressed,

さっき　黙れって　言いましたよね
lines2: 言うことが　変わるのも　会長の　特権です
会長、　自称ですよね

poses: wide shot of the reserve shelf deep in the stacks, one slot filled with a tall stack of books and a name tag,

medium shot, stepping aside to show the whole shelf and counting on her fingers,
lines: ここ、　あなたの　棚。　九冊　あります
lines2: 今週中。　読めなかったら　どうなるかは　その時

medium shot, standing in the dark without turning the light back on, just looking at viewer,

poses: wide shot of the staff door, dangling a key ring from one finger, the dark stacks behind her,
